output.review_comment: The PR correctly fixes the slugify function to pass all tests. The word-boundary truncation logic is well-implemented and sound. The DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH change (40→50) is justified because, as you stated, the tests encode the agreed spec with the content team. The docstring was appropriately updated, so there's no lingering contradiction between code and documentation. The apostrophe removal and explanatory code comments are helpful additions. This is ready to merge.
